newsitem.title: MAURITANIA: Three jailed in Mauritania for links with Libya.
newsitem.headline: Three jailed in Mauritania for links with Libya.

text.p: A court in Mauritania sentenced three people to up to six months in prison for having links with Libya.
One of the five accused received a six-month term while two were jailed for three months. Two others were cautioned and freed at the hearing on Thursday.
A lawyer for those jailed said they would appeal.
Two politicians arrested with the group in January were freed at the end of the month.
Mauritania's relations with Libya, shunned by the West on suspicion of terrorism links, are traditionally strained, with Nouakchott accusing Tripoli of trying to destabilise it.
